movers.headline: board approves a **core steelmaking capacity expansion of 4.8 MTPA at Neelachal Ispat Nigam (NINL)**, a wholly-owned subsidiary, at an **estimated capex of Rs 33,873 cr** — the largest single commitment on the tape today, and a long-products capacity build rather than a maintenance spend. Filed alongside Q1 results: **consolidated EBITDA Rs 9,370 cr**, net debt Rs 45,950 cr (including cash and equivalents of Rs 13,221 cr). *(The raw store flagged this row as a subject-vs-content mismatch and held it out of movers — the subject tag reads 'General Updates'. The filing text is unambiguous, so it leads here.)*

wins a **Rs 2,205.23 cr defence order** — 122 AAAU units and 121 Interface Frames for the **Uttam radar** programme, inclusive of all taxes and GST. At ~13.1% of market cap this is the largest genuine *new* award of the day.

receives a **Notification of Award from ONGC for four Platform Supply Vessels**, Rs 1,032.07 cr including GST, to be completed **within 48 months** of the NOA — a repeat defence-yard customer moving into offshore support tonnage.
secures an **export order of ~USD 46.13 mn (~Rs 441.53 cr) for optical fibre cable** — an export win, so revenue is FX-linked rather than domestic-tender priced.

allots **12,52,629 equity shares on conversion of preferential warrants issued at Rs 530 each**. The allottee list is the story: **Niveshaay Hedgehogs LLP (Arvind Kothari)** takes 40,905 shares, alongside M7 Global Fund PCC – ASAS Global Opportunities Fund, Boring AMCS India Inflection Fund and NKA Resources LLP. *(Marquee flag verified against the filing's own allottee annexure, not inferred.)*

order_wins: **Astra Microwave Products** — Rs 2,205.23 cr, 122 AAAU + 121 Interface Frames for the Uttam radar programme (~13.1% of mcap).
**Garden Reach Shipbuilders** — Rs 1,032.07 cr ONGC award for four Platform Supply Vessels, 48-month delivery (~3.4% of mcap).
**HFCL** — Rs 441.53 cr (~USD 46.13 mn) optical-fibre-cable export order (~1.5% of mcap).
**Jindal Drilling** — Notification of Award from ONGC (value not quantified in the filing).
**Navin Fluorine International** — agreement with DRDO, Ministry of Defence (value not disclosed).
_Not a new order:_ **MTAR Technologies** — an FX amendment to its May-2026 USD 238.76 mn orders, not a fresh award.
business_updates: **Go Fashion (India)** — Q1 FY27 SSSG **+0.6%** for EBOs; near-flat organic growth, so headline revenue is store-addition led.
**Westlife Foodworld** — Q1 FY27 **SSSG +4.3%**, revenue Rs 7.36 bn (+12% YoY), 5 restaurants added to 482 across 79 cities.
other_notable: **Results-heavy tape:** 140 results_outcome rows and 59 earnings-call transcripts filed on the day — collapsed here, tracked in the Results tab.
**Debt / lagging signals, dropped per §3:** Union Bank of India's debt fund-raising board outcome; 23 credit-rating actions.

tally: 2026-07-30: 1,413 announcements captured (00:04–20:20 IST), 428 material rows in the baseline -> 5 verified movers. The day belongs to **Tata Steel's Rs 33,873 cr NINL expansion** — 4.8 MTPA of new long-products capacity, filed under a 'General Updates' subject tag that caused the auto-baseline to flag it as a content mismatch and hold it out of movers entirely; the filing text is unambiguous. **Astra Microwave's Rs 2,205.23 cr Uttam-radar award** is the largest genuine new order at ~13.1% of mcap, followed by **GRSE's Rs 1,032.07 cr ONGC platform-supply-vessel NOA**. **Borosil Renewables'** warrant conversion is the marquee item — Niveshaay Hedgehogs LLP (Arvind Kothari) appears in the filing's own allottee annexure, verified rather than inferred. Three baseline entries were corrected out: MTAR's 'Rs 3,100 cr' is an FX amendment to an order already reported in May, JBM Auto's 'Rs 1,500 cr fund raise' is really its Q1 result (PAT Rs 42.43 cr, +15.96%), and B.R. Goyal / Raconteur / Kanel are extraction artefacts. Two clean operating updates sit in themes: **Westlife SSSG +4.3%** and **Go Fashion SSSG +0.6%**.
